# vmware — 2017 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 56 vmware CVEs of 2017 are in `data/cve/vendors/vmware/2017.jsonl`.

### CVE-2017-4901
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2017-06-08 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Remote code execution
- Exploit-DB 47714: VMware WorkStation 12.5.5 - Virtual Machine Escape (local/windows, 2017-08-08, verified=0)

The drag-and-drop (DnD) function in VMware Workstation 12.x before version 12.5.4 and Fusion 8.x before version 8.5.5 has an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability. This may allow a guest to execute code on the operating system that runs Workstation or Fusion.

Affected:
- VMware / Workstation Pro/Player: affected 12.x prior to 12.5.4
- VMware / Fusion Pro / Fusion: affected 8.x prior to 8.5.5.

References:
- https://www.vmware.com/security/advisories/VMSA-2017-0005.html [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
- http://www.securitytracker.com/id/1038025 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_SECTRACK]
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/96881 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]

### CVE-2017-4905
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2017-06-07 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Information leak
- Exploit-DB 47715: VMware WorkStation 12.5.3 - Virtual Machine Escape (local/windows, 2019-06-06, verified=0)

VMware ESXi 6.5 without patch ESXi650-201703410-SG, 6.0 U3 without patch ESXi600-201703401-SG, 6.0 U2 without patch ESXi600-201703403-SG, 6.0 U1 without patch ESXi600-201703402-SG, 5.5 without patch ESXi550-201703401-SG; Workstation Pro / Player 12.x prior to 12.5.5; and Fusion Pro / Fusion 8.x prior to 8.5.6 have uninitialized memory usage. This issue may lead to an information leak.

Affected:
- VMware / ESXi: affected 6.5 without patch ESXi650-201703410-SG; affected 6.0 U3 without patch ESXi600-201703401-SG; affected 6.0 U2 without patch ESXi600-201703403-SG; affected 6.0 U1 without patch ESXi600-201703402-SG; affected 5.5 without patch ESXi550-201703401-SG
- VMware / Workstation Pro / Player: affected 12.x prior to 12.5.5
- VMware / Fusion Pro / Fusion: affected 8.x prior to 8.5.6

References:

### CVE-2017-4914
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2017-06-07 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Remote Command Execution
- Exploit-DB 42152: VMware vSphere Data Protection 5.x/6.x - Java Deserialization (remote/multiple, 2017-06-10, verified=1)

VMware vSphere Data Protection (VDP) 6.1.x, 6.0.x, 5.8.x, and 5.5.x contains a deserialization issue. Exploitation of this issue may allow a remote attacker to execute commands on the appliance.

Affected:
- VMware / vSphere Data Protection (VDP): affected 6.1.x; affected 6.0.x; affected 5.8.x; affected 5.5.x

### CVE-2017-4915
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2017-05-22 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Privilege Escalation
- Exploit-DB 42045: VMware Workstation for Linux 12.5.2 build-4638234 - ALSA Configuration Host Local Privilege Escalation (local/linux, 2017-05-22, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 47171: VMware Workstation/Player < 12.5.5 - Local Privilege Escalation (local/multiple, 2018-12-30, verified=0)

VMware Workstation Pro/Player contains an insecure library loading vulnerability via ALSA sound driver configuration files. Successful exploitation of this issue may allow unprivileged host users to escalate their privileges to root in a Linux host machine.

Affected:
- VMware / Workstation Pro/Player: affected All 12.x versions prior to version 12.5.6

### CVE-2017-4916
- Assigner: vmware | Published: 2017-05-22 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: NULL pointer dereference
- Exploit-DB 42140: VMware Workstation 12 Pro - Denial of Service (dos/windows, 2017-06-08, verified=1)

VMware Workstation Pro/Player contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that exists in the vstor2 driver. Successful exploitation of this issue may allow host users with normal user privileges to trigger a denial-of-service in a Windows host machine.

Affected:
- VMware / Workstation Pro/Player: affected All 12.x versions prior to version 12.5.6
